A simple way to start.

  1. Find your Franklin listing.
  2. Check the business name, category, location, website and source date.
  3. Prepare a factual correction if something is wrong.
  4. Copy your direct listing link if you want to share it.
  5. Use the Business Growth Planner to choose your next improvement.
